card.text: Explore Enceladus in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Cassini imagery and elevation maps of Saturn’s fractured icy ocean moon.

introduction.text: An icy moon with an ocean beneath its crust. Jets escape through fractures near the south pole, feeding Saturn’s E ring. The Shape view uses JPL’s corrected v2 surface model. The earlier Schenk elevation map retains its separate ellipsoidal height datum.

normal.title: Schenk–McKinnon mosaic
normal.summary: Images are aligned to a common surface model, but source detail varies. Photographed shadows remain; the grid marks gaps.

elevation.title: Stereo and shading terrain model
elevation.summary: Height relative to the source ellipsoid, clipped at ±1 km. Gray grid: missing stereo and shading data.

shape.title: JPL v2 SPC shape model
shape.summary: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Corrected JPL v2 SPC model; the original v1 solution is excluded.

ice-absorption.title: Partial Cassini VIMS water-ice signature
ice-absorption.summary: Near-2.02 µm water-ice absorption in partial Cassini coverage. Gray grid marks gaps. Viewing angle, grain size and archive filtering affect the uncorrected values; these are not ice percentages.

infrared-ratio.title: Partial Cassini VIMS spectral ratio
infrared-ratio.summary: A near-3.1/1.66 µm ice-sensitive ratio with partial Cassini coverage. Viewing angle, grain size and archive filtering affect the uncorrected values. Gray grid marks gaps; this does not measure temperature or crystallinity.
